legend: There are n$$$n$$$ candy boxes in front of Tania. The boxes are arranged in a row from left to right, numbered from 1$$$1$$$ to n$$$n$$$. The i$$$i$$$-th box contains ri$$$r_i$$$ candies, candies have the color ci$$$c_i$$$ (the color can take one of three values ​​— red, green, or blue). All candies inside a single box have the same color (and it is equal to ci$$$c_i$$$).

Initially, Tanya is next to the box number s$$$s$$$. Tanya can move to the neighbor box (that is, with a number that differs by one) or eat candies in the current box. Tanya eats candies instantly, but the movement takes one second.

If Tanya eats candies from the box, then the box itself remains in place, but there is no more candies in it. In other words, Tanya always eats all the candies from the box and candies in the boxes are not refilled.

It is known that Tanya cannot eat candies of the same color one after another (that is, the colors of candies in two consecutive boxes from which she eats candies are always different). In addition, Tanya's appetite is constantly growing, so in each next box from which she eats candies, there should be strictly more candies than in the previous one.
Note that for the first box from which Tanya will eat candies, there are no restrictions on the color and number of candies.
Tanya wants to eat at least k$$$k$$$ candies. What is the minimum number of seconds she will need? Remember that she eats candies instantly, and time is spent only on movements.
input: The first line contains three integers n$$$n$$$, s$$$s$$$ and k$$$k$$$ (1≤n≤50$$$1 \le n \le 50$$$, 1≤s≤n$$$1 \le s \le n$$$, 1≤k≤2000$$$1 \le k \le 2000$$$) — number of the boxes, initial position of Tanya and lower bound on number of candies to eat. The following line contains n$$$n$$$ integers ri$$$r_i$$$ (1≤ri≤50$$$1 \le r_i \le 50$$$) — numbers of candies in the boxes. The third line contains sequence of n$$$n$$$ letters 'R', 'G' and 'B', meaning the colors of candies in the correspondent boxes ('R' for red, 'G' for green, 'B' for blue). Recall that each box contains candies of only one color. The third line contains no spaces.
output: Print minimal number of seconds to eat at least k$$$k$$$ candies. If solution doesn't exist, print "-1".
note: The sequence of actions of Tanya for the first example:
move from the box 3$$$3$$$ to the box 2$$$2$$$;
move from the box 2$$$2$$$ to the box 3$$$3$$$;
move from the box 3$$$3$$$ to the box 4$$$4$$$;
move from the box 4$$$4$$$ to the box 5$$$5$$$;
Since Tanya eats candy instantly, the required time is four seconds.

legend.ai: Tania 面前有 n$$$n$$$ 个糖果盒。这些盒子从左到右排成一行，编号从 1$$$1$$$ 到 n$$$n$$$。第 i$$$i$$$ 个盒子中有 ri$$$r_i$$$ 颗糖果，糖果的颜色为 ci$$$c_i$$$(颜色可以是三种值之一——红色、绿色或蓝色)。单个盒子内的所有糖果颜色都相同(且该颜色等于 ci$$$c_i$$$)。
起初，Tanya 位于编号为 s$$$s$$$ 的盒子旁边。Tanya 可以移动到相邻的盒子(即编号相差一的盒子)，也可以吃当前盒子中的糖果。Tanya 吃糖果是瞬间完成的，但移动需要一秒钟。
如果 Tanya 吃掉了盒子中的糖果，那么盒子本身仍然留在原处，但其中不再有糖果。换句话说，Tanya 总是吃掉盒子中的所有糖果，并且盒子中的糖果不会重新补充。
已知 Tanya 不能连续吃相同颜色的糖果（也就是说，她吃糖果的两个相邻盒子中的糖果颜色总是不同的）。此外，Tanya 的食欲在不断增长，因此在她吃糖果的每个后续盒子中，糖果数量都必须严格多于前一个盒子。
注意，对于 Tanya 将要吃糖果的第一个盒子，其颜色和糖果数量都没有限制。
Tanya 想要至少吃掉 k$$$k$$$ 颗糖果。她最少需要多少秒？记住，她吃糖果是瞬间完成的，只有移动会耗费时间。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n$$$n$$$、s$$$s$$$ 和 k$$$k$$$(1≤n≤50$$$1 \le n \le 50$$$，1≤s≤n$$$1 \le s \le n$$$，1≤k≤2000$$$1 \le k \le 2000$$$)——盒子的数量、Tanya 的初始位置以及要吃的糖果数量下界。下一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 ri$$$r_i$$$(1≤ri≤50$$$1 \le r_i \le 50$$$)——每个盒子中的糖果数量。第三行包含一个由 n$$$n$$$ 个字母“R”、“G”和“B”组成的序列，表示对应盒子中糖果的颜色(“R”表示红色，“G”表示绿色，“B”表示蓝色)。请注意，每个盒子中只包含一种颜色的糖果。第三行不包含空格。

output.ai: 输出吃掉至少 k$$$k$$$ 颗糖果所需的最少秒数。如果不存在解，输出 "-1"。

note.ai: 第一个样例中 Tanya 的操作序列：
从盒子 3$$$3$$$ 吃一颗糖果；
由于 Tanya 吃糖果不需要时间，所需时间为四秒。
